blocks.text: MANILA – The Commission on Filipinos Overseas (CFO) is advising Filipinos living abroad to verify the credentials of cargo forwarders before sending balikbayan boxes this Christmas season, following reports of thousands of packages being left unclaimed at Philippine ports.
